2026-03-30 03:00 AM (Asia/Seoul)

CRITICAL ISSUES - ALL FALSE POSITIVES (IGNORED AS INSTRUCTED):
- tavily-search: 2 env-harvesting issues (scripts/extract.mjs, scripts/search.mjs)
- claude-mem: 7 issues (bun-runner.js, context-generator.cjs, mcp-server.cjs, smart-install.js, worker-cli.js)
- writing-skills: 1 dangerous-exec issue (render-graphs.js)

1. gateway.trusted_proxies_missing
   - Issue: Reverse proxy headers not trusted (gateway.trustedProxies is empty)
   - Risk: If exposing Control UI through reverse proxy, local-client checks could be spoofed
   - Recommendation: Configure gateway.trustedProxies to your proxy IPs or keep Control UI local-only

2. tools.exec.auto_allow_skills_enabled
   - Issue: autoAllowSkills enabled for exec approvals
   - Risk: Implicit skill-bin allowlisting widens host exec trust beyond explicit manual entries
   - Recommendation: Disable autoAllowSkills in exec approvals and maintain tight manual allowlists

3. plugins.tools_reachable_permissive_policy
   - Issue: Extension plugin tools (claude-mem) reachable under permissive tool policy
   - Affected contexts: default, agents.list.main
   - Risk: Plugin tools exposed to agents handling untrusted input
   - Recommendation: Use restrictive profiles (minimal/coding) or explicit tool allowlists that exclude plugin tools

INFO SUMMARY:
- Attack surface: 0 open groups, 1 allowlisted
- Elevated tools: enabled
- Webhooks: disabled
- Internal hooks: enabled
- Browser control: enabled
- Trust model: personal assistant (one trusted operator boundary)
